text:
Type: clear acrylic cantilever chair
Use: dining, working at a desk; dining room, kitchen, home office
Style: modern, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: transparent molded plastic shell, chrome-plated steel cantilever frame
Colors: clear transparent, silver chrome
Shape: one-piece clear curved seat and back, armless, springy chrome tube base bent into a C-shaped cantilever, almost invisible, light and open
Feel: airy, sleek, bright, fresh
Goes with: glass or white tables, chrome, bold colored walls; modern or glam dining rooms and small spaces

product.name: TOBIAS
product.description: You sit comfortably thanks to the restful flexibility of the seat and back.
